label: A4BC_cP24_198_ab_a_a-001
title: $\beta$-SnWO$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
Below 670$^\circ$ this transforms into the \href{current_web_home_dir/A4BC_oP24_52_2e_c_d-001}{$\alpha$-SnWO$_{4}$} structure (Jeitschko, 1972). 
 SnWO$_{4}$ melts above 782$^\circ$C. 
 The current sample was heated above 670$^\circ$C and rapidly quenched. 
 The atoms in \href{current_web_home_dir/AB3C2_cP24_198_a_b_2a-001}{Sn$_{2}$Fe$_{3}$Cl} occupy the same Wyckoff positions, but with different site occupations.
